fields.value: .worktrees/d1-invert was a partially-removed worktree corpse: git had deregistered it but its original/ junction to the real game install was still live. Junction deleted non-recursively first, then 334 MB removed; all 10,938 files verified duplicated in main.

fields.label: Still unmerged, deliberately
fields.value: area/frontend - WIP checkpoint whose PanelSortInit hook (0x00420d00) would go live in the dev ASI unverified

fields.label: Ghidra headless was unreachable from PowerShell
fields.value: bash on PATH is WSL (C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe), not Git Bash. It cannot open a Windows path as an argv entry, so every pool acquire died and decomp_pc.py only ever worked from a Git Bash session. Both decomp_pc.py and ghidra_pool.ps1 now resolve Git Bash explicitly.

fields.label: The gating bucket is xref-shaped, not decomp-shaped
fields.value: Of the 213 still-gating uncertainty rows, 128 need the WRITERS of a global or the CALLERS of a function - not a decompilation. decomp_pc.py --xrefs/--callers already produces that in batch, so it is the next automated lane.

fields.label: Port hazard found (U-4508)
fields.value: The 'pool-commit skips the found-slot pointer' was never a skip - the pointer is passed in EAX (0x004777a5 sets it, the commit block pushes four stack args without touching it, callee reads in_EAX). A cdecl prototype for 0x00477450 silently drops its first argument.

fields.label: Pass 1 - false gates repaired
fields.value: 22 rows claimed to block a promotion their own function had already passed (D0.3 evidence rule, last run 2026-08-15 and never re-run)

fields.label: Pass 2 - resolved with citations
value: U-4417 per-element size, not total or alignment
U-5161 tex+0x14 and tex+0x50 are one field
U-5645 ctx+0x138 is a function pointer

fields.label: Pass 3 - one binary read closed three rows
fields.value: U-4420 / U-4750 / U-4800 all wanted the same unread float. DAT_005d757c = 0.0f. Not a -FLT_MAX sentinel, not a negative bias.

fields.label: Verdicts rejected on review
fields.value: 1 of 5 worker ANSWERED calls did not survive (U-4508 was 'answered' by restating its own premise). Chasing it properly is what found the register-argument hazard.
